rationale: All runs meet hold (>=0.05 ns), DRC and slew/cap with wide room, so only T_eff matters. AREA 3 beat DELAY 3 head-to-head (8.92 vs 9.19); AREA 2 and DELAY 4 stalled near 12 ns, the unrepaired level seen at loose targets. Moving md5's recipe to util 35, a slightly tighter target and higher margins gave the best 8.846; util 38-40 also routed cleanly, and ocs_blitter's util-40 TD run beat its target by 0.76 ns. So keep the winning recipe (AREA 3, ABC buffering+sizing, TD, post-GRT timing+repair, cap213) and push compactness and target: util 42 vs 48, otherwise identical (density delta 10, target 0.47, PL margin 0.30), isolating the util effect.
